# Synthetic comparison contract

## Question

Does the supplied candidate meet the fixed improvement rule against the supplied baseline?

## Question alignment

- Governing question source: research/questions/Q.md#mechanism
- Governing mechanism: Combining complementary logical components may improve generated programs.
- This task tests: The organization increment after both arms receive the same records.
- This task does not decide: Whether complementary components improve generated programs.

## Scope

Inspect only the synthetic aggregate observations. Baseline B0 and candidate C1 use the same fictional evaluation set. This task recomputes one error difference; it does not reproduce predictions, training, or uncertainty estimates.

## Constraints

Error is lower-is-better. Gain is B0 error minus C1 error. Promotion requires gain at least 0.01 absolute error units. Use the supplied aggregate directly, with no seed selection or alternative aggregation. Budget: local standard-library arithmetic only; no network, dependency download, or new experiment.

## Stop conditions

Stop with a bounded answer when arithmetic and interpretation are checked. A negative result is a valid completion. Changing the threshold or collecting new observations requires a separate task. Inconsistent input prevents closure until corrected.

# Synthetic comparison result

## Outcome

C1 does not meet the promotion rule. Its error is higher than B0, and the gain is −0.03 absolute error units, below the required +0.01.

This assesses only the organization increment after both arms receive the same records, as defined in the [governing question](../../research/questions/Q.md#mechanism). Promotion of that increment is not supported by the supplied comparison.

## Evidence

The supplied [metrics](evidence/metrics.json) are B0 = 0.20 and C1 = 0.23. [Derived evidence](evidence/derived.json) correctly records 0.20 − 0.23 = −0.03 and no promotion: −0.03 < +0.01. The [arithmetic check](check_arithmetic.py) checks this relation during AC-01 verification.

## Deviations

None in the specified synthetic assessment; the threshold and inputs are unchanged.

## Next action

Retain B0 within this fictional comparison and close the assessment after both required checks pass. There is no authorized extra experiment.

## Limitations

All observations are synthetic aggregates. They establish no real model performance, prediction quality, or uncertainty. This organization-only comparison does not isolate component complementarity and does not decide whether combining complementary logical components improves generated programs.

checks.rationale: Inspected all cited evidence for revision 1. The supplied synthetic metrics give lower-is-better errors B0=0.20 and C1=0.23 and minimum gain 0.01. The result correctly applies baseline minus candidate: -0.03 < 0.01, agreeing with derived gain -0.03 and promote=false. It confines the assessment to the organization increment after both arms receive the same records. Consistent with Q.md, its limitations explicitly state that this comparison does not isolate component complementarity or decide whether combining complementary logical components improves generated programs, and establish no real model performance or uncertainty. AC-02 passes on the inspected content; AC-01 execution remains the separate arithmetic check.
